sentences.text: Pasta is boiling in the pot.
I like pasta with cheese.
The child ate the pasta quickly.
Hot soup is good in winter.
I eat soup with a spoon.
Mother cooked chicken soup.
Fresh vegetables are from the market.
Vegetables are healthy.
At lunch we add vegetables.
Sweet fruit is plentiful in summer.
I eat fruit after breakfast.
The basket is full of fruit.
The yellow banana is ripe.
I add a banana to breakfast.
The child peeled and ate a banana.
I cut a juicy orange in the morning.
An orange gives vitamins.
The orange peel is thick.
A red apple fell from the tree.
The apple is sweet and crunchy.
Put the apple in the bag.
Potatoes are boiling in the pot.
Fried potatoes are tasty.
We dig potatoes from the soil.
A red tomato goes into the salad.
Tomatoes ripen in the sun.
Slice the tomato with a knife.
The onion stings my eyes.
Onion is the base of a fry-up.
Chop the onion finely.
Butter is spread on bread.
Soft butter is easy to spread.
Take the butter out of the fridge.
Honey sweetens the tea.
Natural honey is healthy.
Honey is kept in a jar.
Cheese tastes good with bread.
Armenian cheese is salty.
Put the cheese on the bread.
The salad is made of fresh vegetables.
We eat salad before lunch.
The green salad is dressed with oil.
Breakfast is an important start to the day.
Breakfast has bread and milk.

sentences.target: շուտ նախաճաշ արեցի ու դուրս եկա։
sentences.text: I had breakfast early and went out.
Lunch is at noon.
Lunch has soup and meat.
After work we eat lunch.
Dinner is served in the evening.
We eat dinner as a family.
A light dinner is better.
I took a book from the shelf.
I read a thick book for a long time.
I am giving the book to my friend.
The notebook is open for class.
A new notebook has clean pages.
Take the notebook out of the bag.
The blue pen writes well.
The pen ran out of ink.
Put the pen by the notebook.
Sharpen the pencil with a sharpener.
A wooden pencil is for drawing.
A pencil erases easily.
The table is set for lunch.
The wooden table is sturdy.
Move the table near the window.
The chair stands by the table.
A soft chair is comfortable.
Take the chair back to the room.
The bed has a soft pillow.
The bed is placed by the wall.
In the evening I go to bed.
The door opens slowly.
A heavy door needs strength.
Lock the door with a key.
The window lets in the sun.
The window is closed at night.
Open the window for fresh air.
I keep the key in my pocket.
A lost key is hard to find.
Put the key in the door lock.
The phone is ringing in the pocket.
I am calling my friend on the phone.
The new phone takes photos.
The computer is working on the table.
The computer sends an email.
The school computer is slow.
The television turns on in the evening.
The television shows the news.
A big television hangs on the wall.
The radio plays music.
The radio tells the news in the morning.
The old radio still works.
The bag has become heavy.
I carry the bag on my shoulder.
An empty bag is light.
Clothes hang in the wardrobe.
I put on clean clothes in the morning.
The clothes are in the washing machine.
The shoes are placed by the door.
New shoes pinch my feet.
Clean the shoes of mud.
A hat protects from the sun.
A warm hat is needed in winter.
Take the hat off indoors.
The shirt has buttons.
The white shirt is clean.
Iron the shirt carefully.
Take the pants out of the wardrobe.
The blue pants are long on me.
Pants need a belt.
The dress is sewn for a holiday.
The red dress suits her well.
Try on the dress in front of the mirror.
A jacket warms you in autumn.

sentences.target: թեթև բաճկոն զով երեկոյին է հերիք։
sentences.text: A light jacket is enough on a cool evening.
Take the jacket from the hanger.

It is necessary to save money.

The dram has coins and banknotes.
I bought the ticket at the station.
A cheap ticket is hard to find.
Show the ticket to the conductor.
The map shows the road.
Open the map on the table.
An old map is kept in the museum.
I wrapped a gift for the birthday.
A small gift comes from the heart.
Put the gift in the box.
The box is heavy to lift.
A wooden box is kept in the cellar.
The box is full of tools.
Soap cleans the hands.
Fragrant soap is in the bathroom.
Wash with soap and water.
A towel is needed after a bath.
A soft towel dries the body.
Take the towel from the hanger.
The mirror hangs on the wall.
The mirror shows my face.
A round mirror stands on the table.

Put the cup by the sink.

A deep plate is for soup.
Wash the plate and dry it.
